2608.23086.title: POOL: Propagated Uncertainty Over Lookalikes
2608.23086.paper_summary: Black-box large language models need confidence scores that can separate likely-correct from likely-incorrect outputs, enabling systems to prioritize human review, route uncertain cases to stronger models, or choose abstention thresholds on development data. Yet existing confidence estimators face a cost-quality trade-off: verbal confidence is cheap but is often overconfident, while sampling-based uncertainty is more informative but scales linearly with the number of samples per query. We propose \textsc{POOL} (\emph{Propagated Uncertainty Over Lookalikes}),a cost-efficient framework that addresses this trade-off taking inspiration from group-testing.\textsc{POOL} clusters query stems with overlaps, evaluates a base estimator on representative medoids, softly propagates confidence scores to nearby queries, and selectively evaluates high-disagreement cases. We instantiate this framework with \textsc{Hy@}$p$, a hybrid estimator that combines verbal confidence with spectral answer diversity computed from the negative von Neumann entropy of sampled answer embeddings.Across six domains from three datasets and five black-box LLMs, \textsc{Hy@}5 achieves higher average AUROC than verbal confidence and \textsc{Vn@}10 sampling while using half as many samples as \textsc{Vn@}10. \textsc{POOL}-\textsc{Hy@}5 retains 93.5--97.9\% of its AUROC while saving 19.3--39.3\% of generations. On paraphrase-dense workloads, generation savings rise to 73-76\%, showing that semantic redundancy can be leveraged to lower confidence-estimation costs.
2608.23086.paper_summary_zh: 黑箱大型語言模型需要能夠區分可能正確與可能不正確輸出的信心分數，這使得系統能夠優先考慮人類審查，將不確定的案例轉交給更強的模型，或在開發數據上選擇放棄閾值。 然而，現有的信心估計器面臨成本與質量的權衡：口頭信心成本低但往往過於自信，而基於抽樣的不確定性更具信息性，但與每個查詢的樣本數呈線性增長。我們提出了\textsc{POOL}（\emph{Propagated Uncertainty Over Lookalikes}），這是一個成本效益高的框架，從群體測試中獲取靈感以解決這一權衡。\textsc{POOL}對查詢樹幹進行重疊聚類，對代表性中位數評估基礎估計器，將信心分數柔性傳播到附近查詢，並選擇性評估高分歧案例。我們用\textsc{Hy@}$p$實現了這一框架，這是一種混合估計器，結合了口頭信心和從抽樣答案嵌入的負冯·諾依曼熵計算的光譜答案多樣性。在來自三個數據集和五個黑箱LLM的六個領域中，\textsc{Hy@}5的平均AUROC高於口頭信心和\textsc{Vn@}10抽樣，同時使用的樣本數僅為\textsc{Vn@}10的一半。\textsc{POOL}-\textsc{Hy@}5在節省19.3--39.3\%的生成數據的同時，保留了93.5--97.9\%的AUROC。在重述密集的工作負載中，生成節省提高到73-76\%，顯示語義冗餘可以被利用來降低信心估計成本。
